responsibility: Instantiates the LoongArch backend’s static property tables declared in loongarch-def.h. It binds enum codes to canonical strings, defines default ISA compositions for architecture types, per-tune cache and alignment settings, issue-rate and DFA lookahead parameters, RTX cost-model defaults and size-optimization costs, and ABI-minimum ISA requirements, providing the backend’s central compile-time database for option resolution, tuning, diagnostics, and scheduling heuristics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling loongarch-def.h header, this source file instantiates and initializes the LoongArch property tables and default cost/cache/alignment data declared there, supplying concrete backend data rather than the shared type codes, structs, and extern interfaces.
